intent.purpose: slideshow frame: close selfie leaning toward the phone in a bright kitchen
intent.scene_concept: woman leaning forward into a front-camera selfie in an ordinary daylight kitchen, one hand at her neckline
intent.place_type: ordinary home kitchen (not a showroom kitchen)
must_stay_true: she leans in toward the camera so her face is close and large
a real, used kitchen behind her

subject.description: one woman in a casual dress about to head out
subject.action: leaning toward the phone held at arm's length, left hand lightly adjusting the dress neckline
subject.pose: torso tipped forward, shoulders rolled slightly in, head tilted
subject.expression: calm, mouth closed, slight lift at one corner

identity.skin: light-medium warm skin, light freckles on the nose, a small beauty mark on the jaw, visible pores
identity.hair: beige-blonde hair with darker roots in a loose low bun, two long face-framing strands
identity.face: light everyday makeup, natural brows, lips with a little balm; natural asymmetry

physique.detail: head, shoulders and upper chest visible

items: deep red cotton slip dress with thin straps and a simple lace-trim neckline
wardrobe.fit_and_condition: one strap slightly twisted, fabric creased at the waist

environment.setting: small home kitchen in the morning
background: white cabinets with one door not fully closed
counter with a kettle, a fruit bowl with bananas, a cutting board and a jar of utensils
window with sheer curtain at frame left
a fridge with a few magnets and a paper note
environment.clutter: normal: mug in the sink, tea towel over the oven handle

camera.position: arm's length, at eye level, the arm reaching toward the camera from frame right
camera.depth_of_field: deep; the kitchen is recognisable, only slightly soft

composition.crop: top of the bun cut off; one shoulder cut at the frame edge

sources: window daylight from the front-left through a sheer curtain
warm under-cabinet light on at the back
lighting.quality: soft, slightly uneven; one side of the face brighter
lighting.exposure: face well exposed, window area slightly clipped

color.saturation: natural; the red dress reads strongly
casts: slight warm cast near the under-cabinet light

processing.sharpening: default phone sharpening on lashes and earrings

imperfections: slight wide-angle enlargement of the nose and forehead from the close distance
a faint lens smudge haze near the window

texture.skin: pores, freckles, fine peach fuzz, slight shine on the nose
texture.hair: loose strands and flyaways, darker roots
texture.fabric: matte cotton with creases and a lace trim that shows its thread
texture.surfaces: painted cabinets, stainless kettle with a window reflection

anatomy: the selfie arm extends toward the lens from frame right and leaves the frame
the left hand has five fingers and lightly pinches the neckline
neck and shoulders consistent with the forward lean
physics: earrings hang forward slightly with the lean
straps follow the shoulders under tension
geometry.reflections: the kettle reflects the window as a soft bright shape; no readable reflections
geometry.perspective: close front-camera perspective, face slightly enlarged relative to shoulders, no fisheye

phone.hold: the phone is the camera and is not visible

typography.scene_text: the paper note on the fridge is too small and soft to read

brands_and_props.branding_policy: keep natural branding: a real-looking kettle maker's logo is fine; do not invent new readable text

exclusions: no Apple Watch or any smartwatch
no fashion-editorial pose or studio light
no beauty filter or poreless skin
